searchText: 2am, <@557201004060213248> sleeping 😴 no way 🙂 Eth2 devs never sleep I took a nap earlier but it was on accident Hello All, in my lodestar client, when I do initial sync for Medalla some peers consistently return us 0 blocks for `beacon_blocks_by_range`. I'm curious if any of us have same issues? hmm, the only reason you should get 0 blocks returned is if the client thought there were no blocks in the entire requested range. Otherwise they should return at least one. How many slots are you requesting for each request? it's 10-20 slots per request, and I only get issue with some specific peers for all other peers, it returns me correctly Interesting. There were some peers on Altona that were throttling very aggressively and only returned 1 block, but I haven't seen one return 0. The aggregator primarily aggregates all the individual attestations block producers usually do not have access to individual attestations, those mostly fall to the aggregator the aggregator will the broadcast their aggrgegates throughout the network, and block proposers will package those aggregates into blocks kk understood it looks like nimbus currently has an issue including attestations, all blocks proposed by nimbus only contain attestations that include few validators https://beaconcha.in/blocks?q=Nimbus%200.5.0%20(6d3f1b9) Now i'm seeing an attestation-effectiveness of >100%. excerpts.author: tuyen4818
excerpts.content:
Hello All,
in my lodestar client, when I do initial sync for Medalla some peers consistently return us 0 blocks for `beacon_blocks_by_range`. I'm curious if any of us have same issues?

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: hmm, the only reason you should get 0 blocks returned is if the client thought there were no blocks in the entire requested range.  Otherwise they should return at least one.  How many slots are you requesting for each request?

excerpts.author: tuyen4818
excerpts.content: it's 10-20 slots per request, and I only get issue with some specific peers

excerpts.author: tuyen4818
excerpts.content: for all other peers, it returns me correctly

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: Interesting.  There were some peers on Altona that were throttling very aggressively and only returned 1 block, but I haven't seen one return 0.  Although, Teku would wind up disconnecting them pretty quickly for not providing the blocks they claim to have.

excerpts.author: tuyen4818
excerpts.content: it happens frequently, if you haven't seen it then I need to look into the way we handle `beacon_blocks_by_range` response too
